knowledge_items.statement: At the reviewed HighBar candidate, serialization or allocation can throw before the trace exception boundary, constructor allocation can leak an opened descriptor, and a failed Record can be followed by a successful retry because failure is not permanently latched. Call sites ignore false and no production consumer authenticates failed state, so a valid-looking truncated prefix could qualify while trace I/O also changes command flow. The repair requires RAII ownership, a permanent nonthrowing failure latch visible to custody, second-call refusal, and unchanged command application.
knowledge_items.title: Trace exceptions escaped and did not permanently expose failure

If the leader exits after TERM while an owned descendant ignores TERM, cleanup reports unknown and leaves the descendant alive.
